name: Altria Group
description: Altria is the largest US cigarette company. Its subsidiary Philip Morris USA sells Marlboro, the best-selling US cigarette for over 50 years, which held 40.5% of all US cigarette retail sales in FY2025. It also makes cigars (Black & Mild, through Middleton), moist smokeless tobacco such as Copenhagen and Skoal (through U.S. Smokeless Tobacco), and the on! nicotine pouch (through Helix). It sells only in the US, apart from contract-manufactured cigarettes for export. Money comes from selling roughly 62 billion cigarettes a year at rising prices while volume falls 8 to 10 percent a year; the cigarette segment earns about a 65 percent adjusted operating margin (Q2 2026). Cash funds a dividend (about a 6.4 percent yield) and buybacks. The smoke-free push has had setbacks: the NJOY e-vapor business was ordered off the US market in March 2025 and written down, and on! has lost share of the nicotine pouch category to Philip Morris International's Zyn and British American Tobacco's Velo. Altria also owns about 8.1 percent of AB InBev and about 42 percent of Cronos, both carried under the equity method rather than at market value.
